title: Normalized coefficient extension on semilinear systems
statement: Fix a category C with object universe c and morphism universe v, a Grothendieck topology J and an EssentiallySmall.{max c v r} instance. Let B and F be towers of commutative ring sheaves in universe max c v r, with transitions tau and sigma, and let alpha_n : B_(n) to F_(n) satisfy alpha_(n+1) followed by sigma_n equals tau_n followed by alpha_n. For the ordinary system models [def-coef-semilinear-system-models], there exists a ScalarSystems structure [def-coef-semilinear-derived-calculus]: normalized derived scalar extension at the sequence site and every level, together with an evaluation isomorphism whose transpose is the specified identity-on-sections restriction comparison. No flatness of alpha is assumed.

proof.text: Obtain normalized derived change-of-rings models for the system map and every level map from semilinearScalarData.
Obtain the level evaluation isomorphisms and their adjunction-transpose formula from semilinearScalarEvaluationTranspose, then package these fields with the selected scalar models into ScalarSystems.
